feeds.title: Stylin' Granny Mama Blog » Fashion
feeds.description: I am a 52-year-old wife, mother, grandmother living in Toledo, Ohio. Stylin' Granny Mama is my personal style blog where I share my fashion ideas and style tips for women over 50.

feeds.title: Holy Toledo History Blog
feeds.description: Holy Toledo History is all about exploring the richness and complexity of the Toledo story through our blog, podcast and history tours. I am Tedd Long. I'm a history geek. I stumble on new photographs, maps, drawings, and documentation all the time. This dynamic space provides a place for me to keep these stories up-to-date.

feeds.title: Toledo Blade
feeds.description: The Blade covers Toledo's news, sports, weather, and entertainment scene, including most of northwest Ohio and southeast Michigan. The Blade's mission is to be the premier source of breaking news and information for northwest Ohio.

feeds.title: Toledo Library Blog
feeds.description: In a region of makers, dreamers, and doers, the Toledo Lucas County Public Library has served as the hub of activity in every neighborhood for 184 years. The Library has free books, movies, music, and programs for everyone. Explore more on our book recommendations, music, events and more!

feeds.title: Mockensturm Blog
feeds.description: This Tax Law blog by Mockensturm, Ltd. discusses significant legal issues for residents of Toledo, Ohio. At Mockensturm, Ltd, our lawyers provide business - and tax-related legal and accounting services for a wide range of clients. We have extensive experience dealing with the IRS as well as state and local tax authorities.

feeds.title: The University of Toledo News
feeds.description: UToledo is one of the most comprehensive universities in the nation. We offer more than 270-degree programs. We teach real-world skills that prepare you for the competitive, global job market. Get the latest news and updates from the University of Toledo, students' stories, campus life stories, and more!

feeds.title: Toledo Center Blog
feeds.description: At Toledo Center, we take an innovative approach to guiding clients and their families using evidence-based approaches to best help each individual and understand that many people struggle with ambivalence or motivation. Our mission is to provide superior treatment for children and teens struggling with eating disorders, including Anorexia Nervosa, Bulimia Nervosa, ARFID, and Binge Eating Disorder.

feeds.title: Mom on the go in Holy Toledo
feeds.description: I am 40 years old, Christian, Catholic, wife, mother to 3 amazing kiddos, a sister, a daughter, and much more. Join me and my family along for our adventures in Toledo & surrounding area. I also enjoy sharing the occasional recipe, philosophical thoughts, and random ramblings of motherhood.

feeds.title: Toledo Real Estate Investors Association Blog
feeds.description: Toledo Real Estate Investors Association is Toledo's only nationally recognized & award-winning real estate investors association (REIA) serving real estate & rental property investors across the state. The Mission Statement of Toledo REIA is to create a forum for real estate investors from beginners to advanced, which will provide effective and responsive services to its members.

feeds.title: Toledo Chamber Blog
feeds.description: The Toledo Regional Chamber of Commerce is a membership organization that addresses the needs of all businesses regardless of size or scope. We provide the buying power, business expertise, connections and advocacy necessary for your business, and our community, to succeed in the New Manufacturing Economy.

feeds.title: Luckybird Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lindsay! Wife, wedding photographer, & human/dog mom. I adore capturing the wild & adventurous moments and I truly care about you & your wedding experience from start to finish. Check out my blog on engagement and wedding photos. I am a Toledo wedding photographer traveling worldwide. I love capturing authentic love stories.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Toledo Blog
feeds.description: Gluten-Free Toledo was created to assist those in the Toledo Area that are gluten-free to find restaurants that accommodate gluten allergies and readily find gluten-free products at local stores. We hope that by sharing our stories and giving ideas and reviews on restaurants and gluten-free products we can help families that have been affected by gluten sensitivity and celiac disease.

feeds.title: Buddhist Temple of Toledo Blog
feeds.description: The Zen Buddhist Temple of Toledo is a not-for-profit organization fostering the teachings of Zen Buddhism as adapted to Western cultural forms and traditions by providing training in the disciplines, practices, and devotions of Zen Buddhism and by providing suitable surroundings, instruction, and support for the teaching and practice of Zen Buddhism.

feeds.title: Vegan Toledo Blog
feeds.description: This site is designed to be a convenient, public and searchable resource for vegans living in Northwest Ohio or Southeast Michigan, for vegans who are visiting the area and for any folks who are curious about how they could eat healthier. One of our goals is to encourage and support restaurants that are doing a good job, as well as to nudge those that could do better. We will do our best to ask every question we can when visiting restaurants.

feeds.title: Smashing Toledo Blog
feeds.description: Smashing Toledo is a positive Toledo food blog showcasing Toledo, OH and surrounding areas great food. Smash Toledo was created in January of 2012 to support and bring together Toledo and the surrounding area food scene in a positive manner. Smash produced videos, hosted dinners, supported non profit events and grew a large social media following.
